```{r}
setwd("~/CSULB/2025 Spring/STAT 560/Project")
mall <- read.csv('Mall_Customers.csv')

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(skimr)
library(scatterplot3d)

skim(mall)
```

```{r}
male_mall <- mall %>% filter(Gender == 'Male')
female_mall <- mall %>% filter(Gender == 'Female')

scatterplot3d(female_mall$Age, female_mall$Annual_Income, female_mall$Spending_Score,
              main = "3D Scatter Plot - Female",
              xlab = "Age",
              ylab = "Annual Income",
              zlab = "Spending Score",
              color = "red",
              pch = 16)


scatterplot3d(male_mall$Age, male_mall$Annual_Income, male_mall$Spending_Score,
              main = "3D Scatter Plot - Male",
              xlab = "Age",
              ylab = "Annual Income",
              zlab = "Spending Score",
              color = "blue",
              pch = 16)
```
